messages:
maya: Heads up — the new ficus by the snack shelf has staged a dramatic lean. We must name it formally so HR respects its boundaries. Photo: https://img.local/office/ficus-tilt.jpg
poll-bot: poll created: "Name the leaning plant" options: 1) Commodore Chlorophyll :seedling: 2) Snack Sentinel :croissant: 3) Compost Admiral :recycle: 4) The Leaning Tower of Basil :herb:
raj: Commodore Chlorophyll ftw :seedling:
lina: Snack Sentinel is iconic lol
sam: I'm voting Compost Admiral to remind interns about composting :recycle:
olivia: Leaning Tower of Basil is peak energy :rofl:
maya: Also establishing a watering rota. Who wants to be on week 1? @raj @lina
raj: I'll take week 1. Remind me with a calendar ping.
lina: week 2 for me. also can we get a tiny nameplate? :name_badge:
sam: tiny plaque idea: "Commodore C." — keeps it classy
olivia: If it dies, we hold a formal memorial with snacks :crying-laugh:
maya: Added a calendar event. watering notes:
```
water: 200ml every 7 days
sun: indirect
note: rotate 90° after watering
```
lina: Love that we now have plant governance. New office meme unlocked.
raj: Next step: plant unionization? :eyes:
poll-bot: poll closed. Commodore Chlorophyll wins with 4 votes.
maya: Officially recorded. Plant is now Commodore Chlorophyll. Long live the Commodore. :anchor:
